recommended_stack.verdict: Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui
recommended_stack.rationale: This is the dominant 2025 stack for personal dashboards with a Python/FastAPI backend. Zero framework overhead vs Next.js, proper component routing for session detail views, and shadcn/ui gives a Linear/Vercel-tier aesthetic out of the box. TanStack Query handles all async data fetching with caching. Zustand for lightweight local UI state (selected session, search query, open panels).

core_libraries.routing: TanStack Router v1 (file-based, typed routes) — or React Router v7 if simpler
core_libraries.data_fetching: TanStack Query v5 (caching, background refetch, loading states)
core_libraries.local_state: Zustand v5 (auth token store, UI state)
core_libraries.animations: GSAP 3 for page transitions + Framer Motion for micro-animations on cards/results
core_libraries.syntax_highlighting: shiki or rehype-highlight (for code blocks in conversations)
core_libraries.command_palette: cmdk (shadcn/ui wraps this for the Cmd+K pattern)

api_layer.pattern: Thin typed fetch wrapper — no axios needed for this scope
api_layer.auth: Bearer token stored in Zustand, injected as Authorization header in all fetch calls. Token sourced from .env (VITE_API_TOKEN) for local dev; for Vercel deployment, proxy through a Vercel serverless function (/api/mcp-proxy) that injects the token server-side from an env var not prefixed with VITE_.
api_layer.mcp_calls: POST / with JSON body {method: 'tools/call', params: {name: '<tool>', arguments: {...}}} — wrap in a typed callTool(name, args) helper

endpoints.health: GET /health — stats, called once on mount, refetched every 60s
endpoints.ingest: POST /ingest — likely out of scope for v1 dashboard

deployment.recommended: Vercel SPA deployment with /api/proxy edge function to hide Bearer token
deployment.alternative: Local-only: Vite dev server, token in .env, no proxy needed
deployment.cors_note: Fly.dev FastAPI backend must have CORS enabled for the Vercel frontend origin. Add allowed_origins in FastAPI middleware.

recommended_stack.reference_template: satnaing/shadcn-admin — open source, Vite + React + TypeScript + shadcn/ui, MIT license, collapsible sidebar, dark mode, mobile sheet navigation. https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin

layout.structure: 3-panel layout: fixed left sidebar (session list) + main content area (session detail or search results) + optional right panel (stats/metadata)
layout.mobile: Sidebar collapses to sheet drawer (shadcn Sheet component). Bottom tab bar optional for: Sessions / Search / Stats
layout.sidebar_width: 260-280px on desktop, full-width sheet on mobile
layout.dark_mode: Dark by default — near-black (#0a0a0b or similar) bg, this is a developer ops tool not a marketing page
layout.aesthetic: Linear / Vercel dashboard register: monospace metadata, subtle borders, muted grays, single accent color (blue or violet)

session_list.card_pattern: Compact list rows (not large cards) — each row shows: project/source tag, session date/time, first human message as preview (truncated to ~80 chars), message count badge
session_list.grouping: Group by date: Today, Yesterday, This Week, Earlier — collapsible date headers
session_list.pagination: Infinite scroll via TanStack Query's useInfiniteQuery — load 20 sessions per page, fetch next on scroll near bottom
session_list.active_state: Selected session row gets left accent border + slightly lighter bg

conversation_viewer.render_style: Document/transcript view — NOT chat bubbles. Full-width, readable like a screenplay.
conversation_viewer.human_turns: Left-aligned label 'You' in muted color + content in standard body text
conversation_viewer.assistant_turns: Left-aligned label 'Claude' in accent color + content in standard body text, markdown rendered
conversation_viewer.tool_calls: Collapsed by default into a single-line summary: '[bash] ls /dev' with expand chevron. Expanded state shows full monospace block with syntax highlight. Tool results similarly collapsed.
conversation_viewer.timestamps: Small, muted timestamp on each message turn — relative (2 min ago) on hover shows absolute ISO
conversation_viewer.scroll: Virtual scroll (TanStack Virtual) if sessions are very long (500+ messages) — prevents DOM explosion
conversation_viewer.copy_button: Copy icon on each message block on hover
conversation_viewer.key_reference: varunr89/claude-transcript-viewer — React viewer specifically for Claude Code JSONL transcripts with collapsible tool calls. https://github.com/varunr89/claude-transcript-viewer

search.entry_point: Cmd+K command palette (cmdk library, wrapped by shadcn Command component) — opens a modal with search input
search.behavior: Debounced 300ms keystroke triggers search_memory MCP call. Show loading spinner inline.
search.result_item: Each result shows: role badge (user/assistant), project tag, session date, snippet with matching terms bolded/highlighted, relevance score as a subtle progress bar or numeric badge
search.highlighting: Bold the matched terms in the snippet — parse the content field and wrap matches in <mark> or <strong>
search.score_display: Show as a small badge: '0.87' in a muted pill — users understand higher = more relevant
search.click_action: Clicking a result navigates to the session detail view, auto-scrolling to the matched message
search.empty_state: Friendly empty state: 'No memories matched. Try broader terms.' with a reset button
search.filters: v1: no filters. v2 consideration: filter by project, date range, role

stats_display.placement: Right sidebar panel on desktop, collapsible section at bottom of mobile layout, or a /stats route
stats_display.visualization: Simple stat cards with large number + label. No complex charts for v1.

reference_implementations.name: varunr89/claude-transcript-viewer
reference_implementations.relevance: Direct match — a React viewer built specifically for Claude Code conversation transcripts with collapsible tool call panels. Study the message rendering and collapse logic.

reference_implementations.name: satnaing/shadcn-admin
reference_implementations.relevance: Open-source Vite + React + shadcn/ui admin dashboard template. Responsive sidebar, dark mode, TypeScript. Closest aesthetic reference to target.

reference_implementations.name: raine/claude-history
reference_implementations.relevance: Fuzzy-search over Claude Code conversation history — similar problem domain, different implementation. Check the data model and search UX.
reference_implementations.use_for: Search UX patterns, data model reference

reference_implementations.name: PCIRCLE-AI/memesh-llm-memory
reference_implementations.relevance: LLM memory layer with SQLite/FTS5 backend (same tech) and a built-in dashboard at localhost:3737. Study the 7-tab layout and memory display patterns.

reference_implementations.name: chatscope/chat-ui-kit-react
reference_implementations.relevance: Mature React chat UI component library. Useful for understanding message layout conventions — though for this dashboard a custom transcript view is better than off-the-shelf chat bubbles.
reference_implementations.use_for: Fallback component reference for message rendering

reference_implementations.name: Algolia Highlighting Guide
reference_implementations.relevance: Canonical reference for search result highlighting patterns. The bold-matching-terms approach is exactly what's needed for the search result snippets.

api_calls: Wrap all MCP tool calls in a single typed helper: callTool(name, args) that handles auth header injection, error parsing, and retry on 401
Use TanStack Query keys like ['sessions', page] and ['session', id] and ['search', query] for automatic deduplication and cache management
Prefetch the next page of sessions when user is 80% scrolled through current page
Show stale data while refetching (TanStack Query staleTime: 30000) — memory data doesn't change in real time
auth: For local dev: store Bearer token in .env as VITE_API_TOKEN, inject in fetch wrapper
For Vercel deployment: create /api/proxy.ts Vercel serverless function that reads process.env.API_TOKEN (server-side only, no VITE_ prefix) and forwards requests to the Fly.dev backend
Never log the token — mask it in any debug output
On 401 response: show an 'Invalid token' banner, don't silently fail
conversation_rendering: Parse message content with react-markdown for assistant turns — Claude responses are almost always markdown
Detect code blocks in content and use shiki for syntax highlighting with the same dark theme as the dashboard
Tool call blocks should show: tool name as header, parameters as collapsible JSON, result as collapsible monospace block
Add a 'Copy message' button that appears on hover — power users will want to copy snippets
For very long tool outputs (bash results, file reads), truncate at 50 lines with 'Show more' — prevents layout explosion
Consider virtualizing the message list if sessions exceed ~200 messages — TanStack Virtual handles this
search_ux: Debounce search input at 300ms — avoid hammering the API on every keystroke
Show the score field from search results as a relevance indicator — users find it useful for calibrating queries
Highlight matched terms in result snippets by bolding them — this is the primary UX signal for why a result appeared
Group results by session_id when multiple results come from the same conversation
Keyboard-navigate search results (arrow keys, Enter to open) — this is a power-user tool
mobile: Use shadcn Sheet for the sidebar drawer on mobile — renders as bottom-up or left-edge drawer
Touch-friendly tap targets: minimum 44px height on all interactive elements
Conversation viewer renders well on mobile in single-column transcript style — chat bubbles would overflow
Search results stack vertically with larger tap areas on mobile
Consider a sticky bottom bar on mobile: Sessions | Search | Stats — 3 tabs max
performance: TanStack Query caches session list and individual sessions — navigating back to a session should be instant
Use React.memo on session list items — the list re-renders on search input changes otherwise
Lazy-load the conversation viewer route — it imports markdown + syntax highlighting which are heavy
Use Vite code splitting: the command palette (cmdk) and conversation viewer should be separate chunks
design_system: Use shadcn/ui components as the base — they are Radix-primitives wrapped in Tailwind, fully accessible and dark-mode ready
Set a single accent color (recommend: violet or blue) — use it for Claude turn labels, active states, and focus rings
Monospace font for all metadata: timestamps, session IDs, scores, project tags — Geist Mono or JetBrains Mono
Sans-serif for body content: Geist or Inter
Keep the conversation content area max-width ~720px centered — same as a readable document column
Subtle animations: GSAP for page transitions (fade + slight upward translate), Framer Motion for search result entrance (stagger)
